question: Who inaugurated the University Grants Commission (UGC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maulana Abul Kalam Azad**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, the then Minister of Education, Natural Resources and Scientific Research, inaugurated the University Grants Commission (UGC) on December 28, 1953. 
 
• The **UGC is a statutory body of the Government of India** that was established to maintain, coordinate, and determine the standards of university education in India. 
 
• The UGC'**s head office is located in New Delhi,** and it has regional offices in Hyderabad, Bangalore, Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhopal, and Pune. 
 
• **The UGC's main functions include: **
 
 
• Approving universities in India
 
• Allocating funds to funded institutions
 
• Providing expert advice to the Government on the strategic development and resource requirements of higher education
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. BR Ambedkar****​**

 
 
• Dr. B. R. Ambedkar was an Indian jurist, politician, and social reformer.
 
• He is considered the father of the Indian constitution.
